'''Kapaz PFK''' ({{langx|az|Kəpəz Peşəkar Futbol Klubu}}, {{IPA|az|cæˈpæz|pron}}), is an Azerbaijani [[association football|football]] club based in [[Ganja, Azerbaijan|Ganja]], which competes in the [[Azerbaijan Premier League]], the highest tier of [[Football in Azerbaijan|Azerbaijan football]]. The club was founded as Toxucu in 1959. They have won the Azerbaijani Championship 3 times and the Azerbaijani Football Cup 4 times.

The team's colours are yellow and blue. The club plays at [[Ganja City Stadium]] which has a capacity of 15.343.<ref>[https://web.archive.org/web/20140827081256/http://www.soccermanager.com/stadium.php?stadiumdid=2429 Ganja City Stadium]</ref>"}}
